From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: POC preflight: environment access & secrets ownership (MAP milestone)

Thanks Jordan — adding technical details and a proposed owner matrix below. Privacy: keeping KMS keys customer-managed is fine; we'll need the following to complete the integration.

Redwood asks / tech needs:
- VPC peering: please provide the VPC ID, CIDR(s), and preferred peering/route table contacts. We'll provide our peering acceptance parameters and test IP ranges.
- IP allowlist: we will require the source CIDRs for the Redwood egress that will hit your controls; I will attach a small script to verify connectivity during the smoke test (I put it in the Drive link).
- SAML/SSO: we support SAML 2.0. Please send IdP metadata and a test user with assertion for email + groups. For the POC it is OK to disable MFA for the test users if your policy permits.
- KMS/secrets: if OpenTech will provide KMS, we need a policy allowing encryption/decryption for the POC role ARN: arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/poc-kms-access (we'll send the exact ARN). Rotation: we support key rotations; typical rotation window for short lived creds is 24 hours for service tokens, and KMS keys can have annual rotation for customer control — for the POC we'll accept manual rotations.

Proposed owner matrix (brief):
- Network / VPC peering: Jordan Hart (OpenTech) / Karthik Iyer (Redwood infra)
- SSO metadata & test users: Sreena Patel (OpenTech) / Marissa Cole (Redwood DX)
- KMS policy & secrets: Arjun Menon (OpenTech) / Karthik Iyer (Redwood)
- Connectivity validation: OpenTech network + Redwood infra (smoke test)

I've attached a minimal checklist (sso-kms-checklist.xlsx) and a peering diagram (vpc-peering-diagram.png) to this thread. Marissa — can you confirm whether Redwood needs any additional audit logging artifacts for the POC?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Great — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround and clear owners. Short recap / agreed MAP updates below so we have a single source of truth going into the infra sync on Dec 1.

Agreed owners & immediate deliverables (due Nov 30 unless noted):
- Jordan Hart (OpenTech) — provide IdP metadata XML, create two test users, provide VPC ID & CIDR list; confirm ops@opentech.io as the peering contact.
- Sreena Patel (OpenTech) — validate KMS policy snippet with Arjun and confirm rotation cadence for the POC (reply by Nov 30).
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — supply Redwood IAM role ARN and the peering acceptance template; provide the connectivity test script ahead of Dec 3 test.
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — confirm audit/logging artifacts Redwood will emit for the POC and whether additional retention configuration is required for OpenTech compliance.

Timeline (updated):
- Nov 30: exchange IdP metadata and KMS policy snippet (owners above)
- Dec 1: Infra sync (30 min) — 1:30pm PT (calendar invite sent)
- Dec 3: Connectivity smoke test (Redwood infra + OpenTech network)
- Dec 7: POC E2E smoke test

Risks / blockers:
- If OpenTech requires strict MFA enforcement on IdP for all test users, we may need the test window extended by 48 hours.
- KMS policy misconfiguration will block secrets injection; please flag early.

I've updated the MAP draft and uploaded a new version to the Drive link. Please reply-all with any changes to owners or constraints; otherwise we'll proceed with the infra sync invite and prerequisite artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
